content:
The leaf shows:
- Scattered whitish-gray powdery patches distributed across the upper leaf surface
- No necrotic margins, no dark lesions, no stem dieback
- Patches are irregular, dusty/chalky in texture
- Underlying leaf tissue still green, not brown or blackened
- No sooty black coating (which would indicate Sooty Mould)
- No sunken lesions or tip/margin necrosis (which would indicate Anthracnose or Die Back)

This pattern — white-gray powdery colonies spread across the lamina — is classic Powdery Mildew.
